requiredFindings.title: The helper invocation exits successfully without publishing
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Item 5a re-executes std::env::current_exe() with --exact on one #[ignore]d helper test and treats a successful exit as the publication having finished, then calls prepare_commit and publish. The Rust test harness does not run an ignored test unless --ignored or --include-ignored is set. On rustc 1.95.0, --test --exact helper printed 'ignored' and exited 0; --ignored --exact and --include-ignored --exact ran the body. Item 5a passes neither flag, so the waited success is a process that did not publish, and B6 and B7 continue against the trust view the handoff already held. The same entry cannot name the publisher: X9 item 6 places it inside crash_matrix_support, which exists only under crash-matrix, item 4b keeps that module off the scenario-fixtures host test (X9 item 2), and item 4c withdraws publish_revocation without listing a scenario function the helper calls. Required: the re-executed process runs the fenced publisher before it exits 0, in a process that never ran operation and holds no operation lease. An ignored entry is spawned with the harness flag that runs ignored tests, or the entry is an ordinary test in the shape of X9 item 3 and publishes only when the helper environment is set. The publisher is callable from that host test under scenario-fixtures alone, through scenario, with crash-matrix off. The test thread waits for that process, then calls prepare_commit and publish, with no sleep.
